clauses.scope_note: Applies to use of the supplied software; the required mention of the original work and contact information for the original project and author must appear in the license. The text says this applies to any use.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_occurs means the software is being used for any use; the required license contents are the original-work mention and contact information for the original project and author.

coverage_notes: Lines 3–17 identify third-party libraries and tools that may be governed by separate or different licenses, and point to their license files; those terms are not supplied here and are not reconstructed.
The supplied text does not state broader permissions or restrictions for copying, modifying, distributing, commercial use, or other activities.
